items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Chet Huntley' and 'Huntley and Brinkley Report' in the context of a TV announcement, but the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not respond with any personal interaction or relationship details.

ctx.x: I wanted to be with my family. I gave the guys a year’s notice, which no-one believed. It was documented by NBC with . . .
. . . Huntley and Brinkley Report. We were playing in Pittsburgh in a big hotel with a big ballroom. They announced – if Iola, you can remember – a national . . .
